name: Ren'ai Hotel: Himitsu no Room Service
original_name: 恋愛ホテル秘密のルームサービス
source:
"Won't you please confort me...?"
Gentle words that struck into your heartbroken chest.
The one who uttered them was a super VIP customer in a hotel you work in.

“Come to my room when you're done with work. Can't you offer that service?"

In this romantic and chest-pounding game, will you be able to resist temptation?
